destinations.name: Anuradhapura
destinations.summary: Explore Sri Lanka's ancient sacred capital, known for monumental stupas and archaeological sites.
destinations.tagline: Where the island's story first took shape
destinations.subtitle: Sacred city of the north-central plains
destinations.intro: Great white dagobas rise above quiet reservoirs and shaded monastery ruins in the first of Sri Lanka's royal capitals. Pilgrims in white still walk between the shrines, so a slow, early-morning visit with your guide is the best way to feel the place.

attractions.name: Ruwanwelisaya
attractions.description: A vast, gleaming white stupa ringed by a wall of carved elephants, and one of the most revered shrines on the island.
attractions.note: TODO verify against a reliable source

attractions.name: Sri Maha Bodhi
attractions.description: A sacred fig tree honoured by Buddhists for more than two thousand years, with daily offerings of flowers and chanting.
attractions.note: TODO verify against a reliable source

attractions.name: Abhayagiri
attractions.description: The extensive grounds of a once-powerful monastery, with a towering brick dagoba, guardstones and moonstones in the forest.
attractions.note: TODO verify against a reliable source

attractions.name: Jetavanaramaya
attractions.description: A colossal brick stupa that ranks among the tallest structures built in the ancient world.
attractions.note: TODO verify against a reliable source

destinations.bestTimeToVisit: Pleasant most of the year; the driest months are roughly May to September. Avoid the midday heat and wear clothing that covers shoulders and knees.
destinations.howToGetThere: Around 4–5 hours by road from Colombo or the airport, or about 1.5 hours from Sigiriya and Dambulla. Your driver can combine it with Mihintale on the same day.
destinations.seoDescription: Discover Anuradhapura, Sri Lanka: highlights, activities and private tour ideas. Plan your tailor-made journey.

destinations.name: Arugam Bay
destinations.summary: Discover eastern surfing beaches alongside lagoons and protected wilderness.
destinations.tagline: Easy-going surf town on the east coast
destinations.subtitle: Waves, lagoons and wild country
destinations.intro: A crescent bay of sand and fishing boats, with point breaks that draw surfers from around the world. Behind the coast lie lagoons, rock hermitages and some of the island's quietest national parks.

attractions.name: Kumana National Park
attractions.description: A remote park of lagoons and dry forest, well known for wetland birds and occasional elephant and leopard sightings.

attractions.name: Learn Surfing
attractions.description: Gentle inside breaks and friendly local schools make this a good place for a first lesson on a board.

attractions.name: Kudumbigala Sanctuary
attractions.description: An ancient forest hermitage of rock shelters and a hilltop stupa with wide views over the jungle.

destinations.bestTimeToVisit: The surf and dry-weather season runs roughly April to October. From November to March the east coast sees more rain and many places close.
destinations.howToGetThere: Around 7–8 hours by road from Colombo, or about 3 hours from Ella. It pairs well with an east-coast or hill-country route.
destinations.seoDescription: Discover Arugam Bay, Sri Lanka: highlights, activities and private tour ideas. Plan your tailor-made journey.

destinations.name: Colombo
destinations.summary: Experience Sri Lanka's commercial capital through architecture, museums, temples and markets.
destinations.tagline: A capital of contrasts by the Indian Ocean
destinations.subtitle: Markets, museums and seafront evenings
destinations.intro: Colonial landmarks, glass towers, temples and busy bazaars share the streets of Sri Lanka's commercial capital. A half-day with your driver-guide is the easiest way to see the highlights without the traffic stress.

attractions.name: Independence Square
attractions.description: A grand memorial hall set in leafy gardens, built to mark the country's independence.

attractions.name: Colombo National Museum
attractions.description: The island's largest museum, with royal regalia, ancient sculpture and art in a white colonial building.

attractions.name: Gangaramaya Temple
attractions.description: A lively temple complex that blends several architectural styles and holds an eclectic museum collection.

destinations.bestTimeToVisit: A good stop all year. December to March is the driest, while the May to September monsoon brings short, heavy showers.
destinations.howToGetThere: About 45 minutes from the international airport. Colombo is usually the first or last night of a tour.
destinations.seoDescription: Discover Colombo, Sri Lanka: highlights, activities and private tour ideas. Plan your tailor-made journey.

destinations.name: Jaffna
destinations.summary: Experience the distinctive Tamil culture and heritage of Sri Lanka's northern peninsula.

destinations.subtitle: Temples, islands and Tamil culture
destinations.intro: On a flat peninsula at the tip of the island, Jaffna has its own flavours, festivals and architecture. Colourful Hindu temples, palmyra palms and little island ferries make it a rewarding trip for curious travellers.

attractions.name: Nallur Temple
attractions.description: A grand Hindu temple with a golden gateway tower, famous for its long summer festival.

attractions.name: Nagadeepa Temple

attractions.name: Delft Island

destinations.bestTimeToVisit: Generally warm and dry; roughly February to September is best. The northeast monsoon brings rain from around October to December.

attractions.name: Whitewater rafting
